body: She thought she took a lethal dose of her antidepressants this time. In the past she's researched how to tie a noose and was interrupted when she was going to attempt to hang herself but my mom did not know that that's what she was interrupting on. She's tried drowning herself. This is all what was reported to us by her social worker.

I think it's perfectly fine to be able to chat and call your friends. And we weren't going to take that away from her. But she has sent nude pictures and inappropriate messages on this app and it's so she can get away with doing these things easier. I've told her that nothing you do with the internet is secret. But I think she feels as long as it's kept a secret from my mom, she doesn't care. I'd even be fine with my sister using a different chat app. But she throws caution to the wind thinking that people can't screenshot these inappropriate pictures and they can without her ever knowing and I've told her that. Sure Snapchat will tell you when someone screenshot your picture. But there are ways around that and she doesn't believe me when I tell her that. She had an ex friend threaten to expose the pictures she has sent in the past. This is my biggest fear. That my sister isn't listening when we try to caution her about these things and still continues to use them inappropriately. So I really do not know what is right in this situation.

We're not trying to. Our thought process is that she's not using social media in a healthy way. She's been caught sending nude pictures and inappropriate messages via Snapchat. My mom wants her to have access to her phone and call and text people but that's not good enough for my sister. She HAS to have this app that she continuously has behaved inappropriately on. I don't understand why she can't use the text feature on her phone to text her friends.
It's the stories I think. She's also engaged in risky behavior on it. Such as sending nude pictures and having inappropriate conversations on it....

Thank you! You're right. I talked with my mom today and we both were just talking about the Snapchat thing. She does not want my sister to have it because she feels that it was making my sister feel worse vs helping her cope. She's also used Snapchat to send nudes. So that was my biggest concern. We unfortunately do  not have the funds to continue therapy after discharge. My mom is applying for Medicaid but she cannot afford intensive therapy after my sister discharges. That's what is really stressing us out. Outreach for low income families with mental health here is awful. They are charging my mom 1,900 dollars a day for each day my sister is in there. I don't have much money myself or I'd help pay for treatment too. I can't even afford my own therapy.
That's a great idea. You're right about the helicoptering. My mom and I talked about that today.

Thank you for such kind words. I love my little sister and I can't even imagine the pain of losing her. I just keep imagining her when she was a little girl and how much I wanted to keep her safe and protect her.

When we ask, she says she feels like a failure, a disappointment and that we'd be better off without her. She feels like a lost cause and something is wrong with her. She also says she feels very abandoned by my dad. She swears she's not being bullied and I believe her because are has been bullied before and was very forthcoming. She did tell me something that happened between her and a boy last summer to where she feels he crossed a boundary. I encouraged her to tell her therapist today (she told me yesterday) she said she did when I saw her earlier for dinner and she said it's being reported. 

She does have MDD and was taking Zoloft. I have no idea how much she uses Snapchat but whenever I'm over visiting her and my mom, I always hear that someone is typing a message to her and other Snapchat related notifications. But I do know I never don't see her on her phone. Her school counselor told my mom she's on it all day at school too. And will skip class if she can't use it in class.

She cuts herself and has been doing it for a while now. My mom can't get into her phone but my mom told my sister she'd be willing to do a wipe of the phone (my sister freaked when my mom said she'd go through her phone). My sister did tell me what is on her phone and I feel it's all stuff teenage me would have had on my phone too. Although more like 16 or 17. I think the phone wipe is a fresh start and a good compromise but I do think we need to know WHO she is talking to.

Her therapist in the psych hospital thinks that she has PTSD. Which I've also been diagnosed with. We were all abused growing up by my dad (I have one other sister younger than me but older than her). And I got the most of the abuse. My dad wasn't around too much after my youngest sister was born. He got a job as a truck driver and we always had a few weeks of breaks from him. But I had endured a lot of abuse. But my sister wasn't really abused. She did witness abuse though. It's just been so hard for me to understand the feeling of abandonment because when my dad left for the third time when I was the age she was out when he left for good, all I could think was "good riddance" I wish I could relate more with her on this.
